items.title: How High Can Mortgage Rates Go? How Does 9% Sound to You?
items.summary: Freddie Mac  weekly survey of fixed 30-year mortgage rates rose to 7.03% this week—the highest level since January 2025—after the  10-year Treasury  yield surged to its highest point in nearly two decades.  If rates over 7% sound like déjà vu, it’s because a number of other measures, such as Bankrate and Mortgage News Daily, have measured mortgage rates at or above 7% for more than a week.  Mortgage News Daily on Thursday, for example, pegged the average 30-year mortgage rate at 7.45%.

items.title: StubHub earns Moody’s upgrade to B2 as debt reduction efforts bear fruit
items.summary: Investing.com -- Moody’s Ratings has upgraded the Corporate Family Rating of StubHub Inc (NYSE:STUB), LLC to B2 from B3, signaling confidence in the live-event ticketing marketplace’s ongoing balance-sheet deleveraging. The rating agency simultaneously raised the company’s Probability of Default Rating and senior secured bank credit facility ratings to B2 while maintaining a stable outlook.

items.title: Moody’s cuts Baidu outlook to negative as AI capital costs weigh on margins
items.summary: Investing.com -- Moody's Ratings has affirmed Baidu Inc (NASDAQ:BIDU) A3 issuer and senior unsecured ratings, but revised its rating outlook to negative from stable as heavy artificial intelligence capital expenditures weigh on cash flow and leverage. items.title: Moody’s: Late-Cycle Credit Risks Are Rising for Weaker Borrowers

items.title: Insurers Are Investing in AI and Private Credit, Moody's Survey Finds
items.summary: More than 40% of U.S. insurers polled by the ratings firm at the end of last year said they plan to increase their exposure to private debt.  It found that life and property insurers rated by Moody's hold roughly $8 billion and $2 billion respectively in data center-related assets.  Moody's estimates that the overall U.S. insurance sector has as much as $20 billion of exposure to data centers.
